title: Privileged access triage: scorecard, routing matrix, and intake playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, measurable intake and prioritization mechanism for privileged/admin access requests (RBAC roles, SSO/SAML integrations, SCIM provisioning, org policy exceptions). Deliverables: a triage scorecard, routing matrix (which queue/team), an intake form template, and a short playbook for PM/SE/Support to execute the flow.
background: Over the last 12 months we have seen an increase in non-bug enterprise requests around admin access: custom RBAC needs, SCIM schema mapping, SAML attribute requirements, and org-level policies. These requests currently sit across Support, Solutions Engineering, and the PM backlog with inconsistent prioritization and long lead times. We need a standardized triage to reduce time-to-first-response and align engineering commits with enterprise SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: Published triage scorecard with weighted criteria and examples
Routing matrix mapping request types to owner queues (Support Tier 2, SE, Security, Eng Infra)
Intake form (Confluence + Support Zendesk template) deployed and linked from Console enterprise admin page
Playbook one-pager for on-call and SE on how to handle emergent high-risk requests
Pilot with 3 enterprise customers and 2 Support reps for two weeks with feedback collected
triage_scorecard: Customer tier: Enterprise (paid committed) = 5, Mid-market = 3, Free = 1
Security/compliance sensitivity: PII/PHI or audit-impacting = 5, Low-risk config = 1
Production impact: outage/blocker = 5, degraded UX = 3, informational = 1
Repeat frequency: recurring request across customers = 4, single-customer one-off = 2
Operational burden: manual process causing monthly ops cost > $X = 4
Time to remediate if not addressed: regulatory deadline/contractual = 5, advisory/opt-in = 1
routing_matrix: RBAC role additions for single customer: route to Solutions Engineering (SE) then to Eng backlog if code change required
RBAC platform changes (policy engine updates): route to Eng Infra with SLA P1 if score >= 15
SSO/SAML attribute mapping questions: Support Tier 2 with SE escalation if custom mapping needed
SCIM provisioning schema changes: Security + Eng if schema affects user lifecycle or audit logs
Org policy exceptions and data residency requests: route to Security & Legal and PM for policy guidance
decisions: Use a 20-point weighted score; requests >= 15 are fast-tracked into the next dedicated enterprise triage weekly slot
Support will own initial intake and must populate triage form fields within 24 hours
Engineering change requests require a minimal PRD linked in intake; SE can author temporary mitigation playbook for urgent cases
Security review set as required boolean for any request touching SSO/SCIM or role elevation
